title: 豫鑫 · 智能调度(auto)分布

panels.title: 近7天 各模型调用量分布

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_name, count() AS calls FROM new_api_logs.logs WHERE created_at > toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND model_name != '' GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: 近7天 模型调用/费用/token 明细

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_name, count() AS calls, sum(quota) AS quota, sum(prompt_tokens) AS in_tok, sum(completion_tokens) AS out_tok FROM new_api_logs.logs WHERE created_at > toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND model_name != '' GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: 每日调用量趋势(按模型)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDate(toDateTime(created_at)) AS day, model_name, count() AS calls FROM new_api_logs.logs WHERE created_at > toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND model_name != '' GROUP BY day, model_name ORDER BY day
